core.title: Northgate autumn concert and exam entries

events.text: Standing policy: once an exam entry has been confirmed with a pupil's peripatetic teacher, the entry date or the teacher named on it may not be changed or withdrawn without that teacher's written consent.
Any external room hire we make that costs more than 150 pounds needs sign-off from Tom Reese, the Deputy Bursar, before the booking is placed.
Marcus Webb writes that he teaches piano at Northgate on Wednesdays and Thursdays and is happy to run grade exam preparation sessions on those afternoons.
Bellwood Exam Board confirms a Grade 3 piano session at the Northgate site on 24 October 2026, entry fee 48 pounds per pupil, closing date for entries 18 September 2026.
Ana Petrov from facilities says the Recital Hall is free on the evening of 12 November 2026, seats 80, and there is no hire charge for school concerts.
Marcus reports that eight of his pupils are ready to be entered for Grade 3 piano this autumn.
Notecraft Music quotes First Piano Album at 7.50 pounds per copy, minimum order 10 copies, quote valid through 30 September 2026.

Priya enters the eight pupils Marcus prepared for the Bellwood Grade 3 piano session on 24 October, paying the board's fee of 48 pounds per pupil, 384 pounds in total, before the 18 September closing date.
Priya books the Recital Hall for the junior autumn concert on 12 November 2026 at 19:00, using the free evening slot with 80 seats that facilities offered.
Priya schedules a mock exam run for the eight Grade 3 piano pupils with Marcus on 15 October 2026 at 16:00 in Room 4, one of his teaching afternoons.
Priya orders 12 copies of First Piano Album from Notecraft Music at 7.50 pounds each, 90 pounds in total, so the Grade 3 group has enough books.
Note: parents of the junior groups have been sent a save-the-date for the autumn concert on 12 November.

Minutes of the term planning meeting: the junior autumn concert stays at the Recital Hall on 12 November, the Grade 3 mock exam stays on 15 October, and the teaching team will send concert programme drafts by 14 October.
Notecraft Music confirms the 12 copies of First Piano Album will be delivered to the Northgate front office in the week of 5 October.
Rosalind Pike writes to say she has been appointed as Northgate's new peripatetic violin and viola teacher from 6 January 2027, and asks whether she can be scheduled on Tuesdays and Fridays.
Marcus confirms he can run the mock exam session on 15 October at 16:00 as planned.
Bellwood Exam Board has issued candidate numbers for the 24 October session and asks candidates to arrive 30 minutes before their slot.
Sam Okafor from Westgate Community Hall offers their main hall on the evening of 12 November for 60 pounds, seating 60, if Northgate wants a cheaper concert venue.
Ana Petrov notes the Recital Hall piano is being tuned on 10 November, so the hall is unavailable that afternoon only; evening bookings on 12 November are unaffected.
Reminder to myself: chase the concert programme drafts from the teaching team this week.
